ns2:course.label: Food Analysis
ns2:course.description: Principles and application of the chemical, physical, and instrumental methods used to determine the constituents of foods; special considerations applicable to the analysis of certain foods. Lecture and lab. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CHEM 232; FSHN 414; FSHN 416 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CHEM 232; FSHN 414; FSHN 416 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
